content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Designs and manufactures asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment; it is an equipment maker, not an MRO distributor."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Distributes MRO supplies, fasteners and safety products to manufacturers and maintenance teams, with outsourced inventory programs like target's."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Distributes MRO products to industrial plant maintenance teams and runs on-site MRO inventory management, closely matching target's model."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Core business is electronic components for electronics OEMs; fasteners are secondary and the customers differ from target's maintenance buyers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures welding and cutting equipment and consumables under its own brands; it is a manufacturer, not a supplies distributor."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products mainly to residential and commercial contractors, a different product set and customer base."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Designs and manufactures papermaking and wood processing equipment; it is a process equipment OEM, not a distributor."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Formulates and manufactures metalworking fluids and specialty chemicals; it is a chemical producer rather than a distributor of tools and supplies."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures locks, hinges and metal castings in its own plants; it is a component maker, not a distributor of MRO supplies."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes custom foam, plastic and composite components to OEM specifications; it is a contract manufacturer with no MRO distribution."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Rents and launders work uniforms and facility supplies on route service; it is a rental and laundering service, not a product distributor."}]}
